## Current work

**Immune control of heart regeneration.** Newborn mammalian hearts can regenerate
after injury; adult hearts cannot. My work shows that the PD-1/PD-L1 checkpoint
pathway maintains the immunosuppressive environment this regenerative window
depends on, and asks how T cell populations are recruited and licensed during
neonatal cardiac injury.

**Self-renewal and ageing of tissue-resident macrophages.** During my PhD I
characterised a short isoform of Piwil2 required for the self-renewal of murine
macrophages, and contributed to work on how alveolar macrophages retain their
epigenetic identity through long-term expansion and how microglia mature in the
developing brain.
